purpose: Measure a compound's effect on cell growth or survival (IC50) from cellular ATP read by CellTiter-Glo; with a kinase-dependent cell line (e.g. Ba/F3 JAK2V617F) and its parental line as counterscreen, it shows on-target cellular activity.
notes: All four exemplars are Scripps Research Institute Molecular Screening Center assays (one lab's format). Source diversity is low.
1691 (JAK2V617F-dependent Ba/F3) and 1699 (parental Ba/F3, IL-3) are a matched pair: the counterscreen separates kinase-driven from general cytotoxicity.
1691/1699: 25 uL at 200,000 cells/mL gives 5,000 cells per well (derived, not stated).
